text:
Priya P. (Eng Mgr): Hi @people-ops, need guidance. Jordan submitted an ADA accommodation request yesterday asking for a flexible start window (10am-1pm) because of chronic migraines. We've also had 3 late arrivals and 1 missed sprint check-in last month and I was about to start a performance conversation. How do we proceed with accommodation vs performance action? Should we pause any formal PIP while we evaluate? :thinking:

Ava G. (People Ops): Thanks Priya. Please don't start a PIP while an accommodation is active. We need to open the interactive process. Can you DM the request or drop the intake link? I'll kick off ADA intake and assign Elena. We'll aim to respond in 7 business days. intake: https://redwood.company/hr/accom-intake :link:

Elena R. (HRBP): Echo Ava — pause disciplinary steps for now. We'll need medical documentation if reasonable, but accommodations can be temporary based on self-attestation for short-term adjustments. I'll schedule a private meet-and-greet with Jordan + Priya + me. Can Priya share a timeline of incidents (dates only) so we have context?

Priya P. (Eng Mgr): Thanks. Timeline below (attendance logs):
```
2026-02-18 - 09:12 AM - 12m late
2026-02-25 - 11:03 AM - 13m late
2026-03-03 - 09:05 AM - 22m late
2026-03-15 - Missed stand (no slack msg)
```
I don't want to block support for Jordan, just want clarity on next steps.

Jordan L.: Hi all — thanks for handling this. I submitted the accom form last night and attached a doctor's note PDF. My migraines have been hard to predict; a later start window would help me be present for core overlap and async work. I'm worried about being put on a PIP — I'm happy to meet and find reasonable adjustments. :pleading_face:

Ava G. (People Ops): Jordan — thanks for filing and for the doc. We'll protect confidentiality. Elena will lead the intake convo. As a next step, Elena, can you propose 2 time slots for a private call? Priya, please avoid documenting disciplinary steps in public tickets until we complete intake.

Elena R. (HRBP): Proposed slots: Mon 3/23 11:00-11:30 or Tue 3/24 15:00-15:30 PT. Jordan, which works?

Jordan L.: Mon 3/23 11 works. Thank you. Also can we discuss temporary remote days as an option? On flare days commuting is the worst.

Priya P. (Eng Mgr): Mon 11 confirmed from my side. I support trying temporary remote or flexible hours as an accommodation. We can document expectations for async deliverables while accommodation is active.

Samir N.: Quick FYI — if accommodation requires schedule change beyond role core hours, loop in ENG leads for coverage. Also recommend adding a check-in cadence (2 weeks) to evaluate impact. :thumbsup:

accom-bot: ADA intake opened (case #AC-2026-482). Assigned to Elena R. Response target: 7 business days.

Ava G. (People Ops): Great — I'll mark this as 'hold' in the performance tracking doc until intake concluded. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
